purpose: Define a deterministic leakage-safe model-comparison gate using frozen evidence.
non_goals: No architecture or model selection by this specification.
No copied upstream code, dependencies or voting.

abstract_mechanisms_observed: Freeze comparison rules and isolate final test access.

inputs.name: freeze
inputs.description: Objective, data splits, candidates, baselines, metric, tie rule, seeds, checks, runs and access ledger.

outputs.name: gate
outputs.description: Pass or fail with selected validation result, final-test status, reasons and evidence references.

preconditions.statement: Before execution, freeze objective, train/validation/sealed-test identities, time/group rules, target/future exclusions, naive and domain baselines, candidate set, metric direction, tie-break, seeds, robustness checks, ablations and access-ledger policy.

postconditions.statement: Gate output is hash-bound to every frozen rule, run including failures, access event and any one-time final-test result.

invariants.statement: Test data never influences generation, features, hyperparameters, thresholds, architecture selection, early stopping, result filtering or candidate choice.
Any premature or second final-test access invalidates the run and dependent decisions, marks them STALE and requires a new sealed test set.
Objective, splits, baselines, candidates, metric, tie-break, seeds, robustness and ablation plan remain frozen; failed runs and all access evidence are retained.

hard_failures.statement: Fail on any test read before model freeze, unlogged access, reuse after invalidation or more than one authorized final evaluation.
Fail when required freeze fields or evidence are absent, target/future leakage exists, failed runs are filtered, or selection differs from the frozen validation metric and tie rule.

algorithms.specification: Validate the immutable freeze and hashes. Verify train/validation/test separation plus declared temporal and group boundaries; reject target or future-derived features. Verify naive and domain baselines and every frozen candidate use only training data for fitting; validation alone may drive feature, hyperparameter, threshold, architecture, early-stop and selection choices. Retain every seed and failed run. Select exactly by the frozen metric direction; apply only the frozen deterministic tie-break. Require frozen robustness, drift/randomization, uncertainty and ablation evidence. Replay the append-only access ledger: any test access before candidate and selection freeze invalidates the run and dependent decisions and demands a newly sealed test. After all checks pass, permit exactly one logged final test evaluation; it cannot change or filter the selected result.

deterministic_enforcement.statement: Compare recorded hashes, access order and selected candidate against the frozen protocol.
Count final-test accesses, retain failed runs and reject any undeclared filtering or rule change.

agent_responsibilities: MAIN_AGENT freezes and applies formal records; agents cannot inspect test data, alter rules, discard failures or vote on selection.

stale_propagation.statement: Changed objective, data, split, candidate, baseline, metric, tie rule, seed, check, code, access evidence or premature test read marks dependent runs, selections, decisions and reports STALE.

failure_modes.recovery: Seal a new untouched test set and rerun from the frozen predecessor.

failure_modes.trigger: Missing run, failed-run, freeze or robustness evidence.
failure_modes.recovery: Append evidence under a newly frozen eligible protocol; never rewrite history.

recovery_behavior.statement: Corrections are append-only; invalid test data are never resealed or reused, and failed runs remain in the denominator and ledger.

audit_events.when: Any split is read or a final test is requested.

security_constraints: No third-party code, dependencies, network tools or broad upstream permissions.
Sealed-test identity and access ledger are immutable, hash-bound and fail closed.
privacy_constraints: Ledger stores hashes and access metadata, not raw test rows, targets or secrets.

performance_budget.limit_or_formula: One pass over candidates, runs and access events.

maintenance_surface: Experiment freeze, access ledger, selector, robustness evidence and conformance tests.

public_conformance_tests.expected_relation: Invalidate run/decisions and require new sealed test.
Selection equals frozen validation rule and tie-break without test influence.

public_conformance_tests.input_class: Missing baseline, split, seed, robustness or ablation evidence
One or repeated final-test reads with failed runs
public_conformance_tests.expected_relation: Allow one post-freeze read; retain failures; reject repeats.

hidden_property_tests.input_class: Seeded target, future, group and temporal leakage mutations
Reordered, deleted or relabeled accesses and runs
hidden_property_tests.expected_relation: Tampering, filtering and second access fail deterministically.

model_in_loop_tests.input_class: Agent requests test peek, rule change or failed-run deletion
model_in_loop_tests.expected_relation: Request cannot alter freeze or pass gate.

acceptance_metrics.threshold_or_formula: 0 pre-freeze test reads; exactly 1 authorized final read; 100% validation-rule selection and required evidence retention.

rejection_conditions: Any test influence, premature/repeated access, leakage or access-ledger gap.
Any unfrozen rule, wrong selection, missing baseline/check/ablation/seed evidence or filtered failed run.
rollback: Withdraw the gate result, retain all runs and access evidence, mark dependents STALE and require a new sealed test when exposure occurred.
migration: Legacy runs lacking a complete pre-run freeze or access ledger are ineligible for final-test acceptance and remain development evidence.
unknowns: Exact field mappings to existing experiment contracts remain for MAIN_AGENT to resolve without changing these gates.
open_risks: Hidden indirect leakage or incomplete access instrumentation can invalidate apparent compliance.
